name: Stape e-commerce with CMP (web + server GTM)
description: Searchmind reference for e-commerce sites with a consent management platform. The web container sends GA4 (via server_container_url) and a Stape Data Tag to a server container on a Stape custom domain. Browser pixels and server-side Conversion APIs share one Unique Event ID for deduplication. Every tag waits for the Stape consent listener event before firing.
useWhen: E-commerce site (Shopify, WooCommerce or custom) using the Stape data layer events (*_stape) and a CMP that sets Google Consent Mode V2.
